formal_research_unit: C3X 0.14 — Transportable Search-Mechanism Evidence, Chess-Concept Mediation & Faithful Explanation Systems
governance: P checkpoints are sections within the single formal C3X 0.14 phase; new 0.15 or 0.16 only upon substantive new research question/frozen protocol, never mere output length. No extra Notion Lab or P child pages.

actual_experiment.interpretation: Among 28 preselected first eligible main TT returns, the last successful producer was main terminal save, typically at the same ply but at greater recorded search depth (19/28), and TT bounds include non-exact lower/upper. Three intervention arms had the same observed first eligible TT event BEFORE returning/suppressing it. Confirms a more precise local program causal attribution but not separate LMR/history/NNUE/chess-concept mediators.

failure_and_correction_provenance.cause: Additional expected sidecar first-eligible provenance read (one per mode) increased first_key_match debug counter. Native SF16 probes/saves, moves/PV/nodes unchanged. Incorrectly required all sidecar counters identical.
Correctly explicitly permit exactly ONE new 64bit-matched sidecar read per run while retaining strict original SF16 probe/save/path/score equivalence and 28/28 three-arm event match.

limits: First TT bound-returnable event and its last native fullfield producer alone do not identify all TT return events; a later bounded event census is needed.
main terminal last writer means the source TTEntry save call, not a proof tree of how that score was derived.
Same writer/search ply does not mean same searched depth. Saved depth may exceed requested consume depth.
BOUND_LOWER and BOUND_UPPER are search window bounds, not exact minimax scores.
Native Thread::completedDepth and UCI PV depth remain separate quantities as previous C3X 0.14 instrument established.
Parallel TT modifications could make sidecar races; these experiments fixed Threads=1 and depth12 to avoid that concern.
Only Stockfish16 local known TCEC source games; cross-engine and human semantic transport not proven.
next_outcome_blind_challenge: Within same 0.14 perform bounded first-K naturally taken TT return event census on OFF (not only first) with true writer class and fullkey+bound, in all 28 frozen worlds. Then source-level separate quiet-history / LMR branch return effects under new precommit. Move to 0.15 only for a genuine factorial-intervention/cross-engine research unit.
